Alice & Bob Helium (on-premise system)

Alice & Bob · superconducting circuits · DEPLOYED (11/18 Jun 2026) · 18 physical qubits · access: on-prem sold + cloud
architecture: קיוביטים בוזוניים בחללים — חתול ו-GKP · Open on the map

Register profile — the machine's variant of its architecture

qubit type: dissipatively stabilised cat qubits
gate mechanism: bosonic gates; Felis SDK compiles noise-biased instruction sets
connectivity: 1-D repetition code for phase flips
control: room-temperature control; self-contained cabinet ~40 kW, 18-25 C
control placement: room-temp
readout: dispersive
codes: cat_repetition
flags: cryogenic details missing, no logical error rate
